lines: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज, निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु, जो दायकु फल चारि॥
en: Cleaning the mirror of my mind with the dust of my Guru's lotus feet, I sing the pure glory of Shri Ram, giver of life's four fruits.

lines: बल बुधि बिद्या देहु मोहिं, हरहु कलेस बिकार॥
en: Knowing I lack wisdom, I remember you, son of the Wind. Give me strength, wisdom and knowledge; take away my troubles and faults.
Victory to Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and virtue. Victory to the lord of the Vanaras, who lights up the three worlds.
Ram's messenger, home of matchless strength, known as Anjani's son and son of the Wind.
Great hero, mighty as a thunderbolt, you remove bad thinking and stand by good sense.
Golden in colour, finely dressed, with earrings and curly hair.
A thunderbolt and a flag shine in your hands; a sacred thread of munja grass adorns your shoulder.
Born of Shiva's grace, joy of Kesari, your radiance and might are honoured by the whole world.
Learned, virtuous and very wise, always eager to do Ram's work.
You love to hear the Lord's story; Ram, Lakshman and Sita live in your heart.
In a tiny form you appeared before Sita; in a fearsome form you set Lanka on fire.
In a giant form you destroyed the demons and completed Ramchandra's mission.
You brought the Sanjeevani herb and revived Lakshman; overjoyed, Ram held you to his heart.

lines: तुम मम प्रिय भरतहि सम भाई॥
en: Ram praised you greatly: "You are as dear to me as my brother Bharat."
"May a thousand mouths sing your glory," said the Lord, and embraced you.
Sanaka and the sages, Brahma and the gods, Narada, Saraswati and Sheshnag...

lines: कबि कोबिद कहि सके कहाँ ते॥
en: ...Yama, Kubera and the guardians of the directions — even poets and scholars cannot fully describe your glory.
You helped Sugriva: you brought him to Ram and he got back his throne.
Vibhishana followed your advice and became king of Lanka, as the whole world knows.
The sun, thousands of yojanas away, you swallowed, thinking it was a sweet fruit.
Holding the Lord's ring in your mouth, you leapt across the ocean — no wonder at all.
Every hard task in the world becomes easy by your grace.
You guard Ram's door; no one enters without your permission.

lines: तुम रच्छक काहू को डर ना॥
en: All happiness is found in your shelter; with you as protector, there is nothing to fear.
Only you can hold your own power; the three worlds tremble at your roar.
Ghosts and evil spirits stay away when the name Mahavir is chanted.
Illness ends and all pain goes away by always chanting the name of brave Hanuman.

lines: मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै॥
en: Hanuman frees from trouble everyone who remembers him in thought, deed and word.

lines: तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा॥
en: Ram, the ascetic king, is above all; you carried out all his work.
Whoever comes to you with any wish receives the endless fruit of life.
Your glory shines through all four ages; your light is famous across the world.
You protect the saints and the good, destroy the demons, and are dear to Ram.

lines: अष्ट सिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता।
en: You can grant the eight powers and nine treasures — a boon from Mother Janaki.
You hold the nectar of Ram's name; may you always remain Ram's servant.
By singing of you one reaches Ram and forgets the sorrows of many lives.
At the end one goes to Ram's abode, and wherever born, is known as Hari's devotee.
Even without thinking of other gods, serving Hanuman brings every happiness.
Troubles are cut away and all pain ends for whoever remembers mighty Hanuman.
Victory, victory, victory to Lord Hanuman! Bless me as my Guru would.

lines: जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई।
en: Whoever recites this a hundred times is freed from bonds and gains great joy.
Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa finds success — Lord Shiva is the witness.
Tulsidas, forever the Lord's servant, prays: make my heart your home.

lines: पवनतनय संकट हरन, मंगल मूरति रूप।
राम लखन सीता सहित, हृदय बसहु सुर भूप॥
en: Son of the Wind, remover of troubles, form of all that is good — live in my heart with Ram, Lakshman and Sita, O king of gods.
